scope: AIOC-only preimplementation contract closure; no Multiversal-app runtime implementation

authority.campaign_membership_and_role: A5 CampaignMembershipAndInvitationPort over the authoritative campaign_members owner family
authority.campaign_owner: CampaignRecord.ownerSubjectId; Campaign ownership is not an A5 membership role and is not created by invitation acceptance
authority.legacy_authorization_adapter: P9 campaign-authorization-policy is a compatibility authorization consumer, not membership truth
authority.pcv02_member_subject_ids: compatibility projection only after migration; never a second membership authority

canonical_membership.role_normalization: A membership has one primary Campaign participation role. Additional scoped authority is represented by separately versioned delegations/grants, not by silently unioning broad roles. This intentionally normalizes F003's 'one or more scoped roles' requirement without losing scoped authority.
canonical_membership.owner_separation: Campaign owner authority is derived from CampaignRecord.ownerSubjectId and is never minted or transferred by Campaign invitation/membership operations.

lifecycle_disposition.scoped_roles: normalized to one primaryRole plus explicit delegation/grant records
lifecycle_disposition.revocation_state: retained through state plus transition timestamps
lifecycle_disposition.concurrency_version: added explicitly as positive integer version

canonical_membership.version_rule: Every role or state transition increments membership version. Public participant/membership projections used for mutation MUST expose the current version and permissionsVersion so expectedVersion can be supplied without an out-of-band hidden read.
canonical_membership.activity_rule: Only active, unexpired membership may contribute Campaign membership authority. suspended/left/removed membership fails closed for entry, command and reconnect until a governed transition restores authority.

allowed_transitions: active -> suspended by currently authorized member manager
suspended -> active by currently authorized member manager
active -> left by the member subject
suspended -> left by the member subject
active -> removed by currently authorized member manager
suspended -> removed by currently authorized member manager
left -> active only through a new governed invitation acceptance
removed -> active only through a new governed invitation acceptance
state_transition_seam.forbidden: Generic state mutation may not reactivate left/removed membership, bypass invitation policy, or mutate ownership.
state_transition_seam.stale_version_rule: expectedVersion mismatch fails as conflict with no mutation.

mutation_authorization_context.rule: A5 mutation requests cannot rely on actorSubjectId alone. The canonical authenticated subject and current authorization decision must agree; authorization is revalidated deny-by-default at mutation time.
mutation_authorization_context.invitation_entitlement_rule: Invitation resolve/accept also carries A3 entitlementDecisionReference and entitlementRulesetVersion where the invitation has entitlement impact.
mutation_authorization_context.scope: Applies to issue/reissue invitation, role change, membership-state transition, assistant-GM delegation grant/revoke and atomic invitation acceptance coordination.

role_translation.purpose: Fail-closed compatibility for older P9 CampaignRole consumers; this translation is not canonical membership truth.

mappings.condition: no direct broad gm translation; use current scoped AssistantGmDelegation and operation-specific authorization
no direct CampaignRole translation; use creator/workspace-specific authorization
CampaignRecord.ownerSubjectId only; never derived from membership or Owner/Admin application status

role_translation.unknown_role_rule: Unknown, unsupported or contextually broader roles fail closed. No fallback to player, gm or owner is allowed.

accepted_binding_sources: opaque claim/reference that resolves exactly once to a canonical subject after PCV-I01A authentication
forbidden_binding_sources: email string without governed identity mapping
invitation_recipient_binding.acceptance_rule: A3 resolve/accept must bind recipientSubjectId to the authenticated StableSubjectSession subject. Device identity may be recorded as context but cannot satisfy recipient identity or grant Campaign role.
invitation_recipient_binding.preauth_rule: Before authentication, invitation preview remains inference-safe and reveals no Campaign/recipient/member identity.
invitation_recipient_binding.owner_admin_rule: A3 owner-admin invitation role is invalid for A5 Campaign membership and cannot transfer Campaign ownership.

acceptance_gate: MIB-17 require-guardian blocks until current matching guardian approval is satisfied
MIB-17 allow permits the policy layer to proceed but grants no Campaign authority
SMB-14 invitation lifecycle/recipient checks must agree with A3 invitation state
family_policy_composition.no_circular_workspace_rule: First Campaign invitation acceptance cannot require pre-existing Campaign workspace entry. PCV-03A must compose the MIB-17 decision and SMB-14 invitation/recipient hardening invariants as an invitation-specific policy gateway rather than requiring SMB-14's broader already-authorized-workspace path wholesale.

atomic_acceptance_coordinator.owner: A3/A5 composition boundary; no PCV-specific membership owner
semantic_transaction: validate current A3 StableSubjectSession and bind authenticated subject
resolve current A3 invitation and recipient binding
evaluate current MIB-17/SMB-14 invitation policy and entitlement impact
lock/read current invitation and A5 membership by canonical keys
create or reactivate the A5 membership with intended primary role and incremented version
mark the A3 invitation accepted with terminal accepted subject/time
persist idempotency/operation receipt and audit/outbox evidence
return A3 InvitationAcceptanceReceipt whose membershipReference/roleReference point to the A5 result
atomic_acceptance_coordinator.atomicity_rule: All authoritative writes above commit in one persistence transaction. Any authorization, policy, uniqueness, version, persistence or audit/outbox precondition failure rolls back the complete authoritative transition.

idempotency.same_key_same_fingerprint: Return the original acceptance result with replayed=true and perform no second membership/role effect.
idempotency.same_key_different_fingerprint: Reject as conflict with no mutation.
idempotency.already_accepted_same_subject_new_key: Return duplicate-acceptance/inference-safe failure; do not create a second membership or role effect.
idempotency.already_accepted_different_subject: Return inference-safe invitation-unavailable; do not disclose accepted subject.

atomic_acceptance_coordinator.transaction_primitive_destination: PCV-I02 defines the concrete installed SQLite/production service transaction primitive; PCV-I01B freezes the required all-or-nothing semantics now.

pcv02_membership_migration.current_state: PCV-02 ProductCampaignFoundation stores memberSubjectIds without membership identity, role, lifecycle state or version.
pcv02_membership_migration.disposition: memberSubjectIds becomes a read-only derived compatibility projection after migration and is never an authoritative write target.
pcv02_membership_migration.derived_projection: campaign ownerSubjectId plus subjectIds from current active A5 memberships, de-duplicated; projection membership does not create authority.
pcv02_membership_migration.owner_rule: The PCV-02 owner entry is explained by CampaignRecord.ownerSubjectId, not by inventing an A5 owner membership.
pcv02_membership_migration.legacy_nonowner_rule: A legacy non-owner memberSubjectId without a matching A5 membership cannot be guessed to be player or any other role. It is migration-pending/quarantined until explicit role/lifecycle evidence is available.
pcv02_membership_migration.pcv03_rule: PCV-03A may read the derived compatibility projection for display/migration only; it must never append/remove memberSubjectIds as a membership mutation.

persistence_delta_contract.operation_receipt_requirement: Durable operation/idempotency evidence must permit exact replay recovery and conflicting-reuse rejection.
persistence_delta_contract.raw_secret_rule: Raw invitation bearer secrets are never stored in ordinary product documents, diagnostics, telemetry or compatibility projections.

downstream_session_rule.launch_snapshot: A5 LaunchParticipantBinding already carries membershipVersion; PCV-03A must source it from the canonical A5 membership projection/record.
downstream_session_rule.reconnect: Suspension/removal/leave or permissions-version drift invalidates stale Session/reconnect authority even if transport/device continuity remains valid.
downstream_session_rule.no_second_join_owner: SMB-02/PCV-03 consume canonical A5 membership; they never mint a parallel session membership.

external_sanity_checks.use: deny by default and validate permissions on every request
bearer-style tokens should be cryptographically random, bounded, single-use and invalidated after use; applied here as an invitation-token sanity check
multi-step authoritative acceptance must be all-or-nothing with intermediate state not visible

runtime_boundary.next_runtime_destination: PCV-03A after PCV-I01C through PCV-I06 predecessor closure

completion_evidence.note: Contract-level closure only. Runtime realization remains PCV-03A; exact persistence/transaction implementation remains additionally owned by PCV-I02.
